content.summary: B&G Foods has acquired all assets in Del Monte Foods’ “Broth & Stock” business segment, including College Inn and Kitchen Basics brands. The company has negotiated asset purchase agreements with the three parties for substantially all of its assets and business operations as going-concern businesses.
